Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You have detailed the cost drivers and previously explained your approval constraints—it sounds like an internally defensible adjustment is essential. We want a fair balance between price and payment timing that supports our long-standing partnership. How could we make that balance work within your approval authority?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €374.84 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
Our management has reviewed your proposal; please note that extending payment terms to 90 days increases our financing costs and cannot result in a price reduction.
We must therefore maintain our standard 30 days payment terms, under which we can offer a slight adjustment to €370.71 per unit.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

Your reply and Credit Control both emphasise payment timing; it sounds like protecting cash flow is central to any price adjustment you can support. We want a sustainable agreement that respects that concern, and we are sharing verified demand evidence without asking you to disclose your internal calculation. What reciprocal adjustment to price and payment timing could you support within your approval authority?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.80 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €373.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
Please note:
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Based on this volume adjustment, we can reduce our price to €373.63 per unit while accepting your requested 90 days payment terms.
As extended payment terms increase our financing costs, this adjustment reflects the maximum concession available under these conditions.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

You have accepted the volume evidence, but explicitly link your concession limit to financing costs—it sounds like the payment burden is now the sticking point. We want a sustainable agreement that recognises that burden and supports our long-standing partnership. How could a reciprocal adjustment to payment timing create room for a fair price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 366.91 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €373.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Dear Sir or Madam,

We note your understanding of our financing constraints regarding extended payment terms.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our current offer is a price of €373.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. We cannot offer further price reductions while maintaining 90 days payment terms. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

As an alternative at our standard terms, to meet your pricing expectations more closely, we propose returning to our standard 30 days payment terms, which allows us to offer a unit price of €369.35, with a price of €369.35 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.

Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
